in_marathi.name: Kayalvizhi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Fortune's Abode
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kayalvizhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kayalvizhi is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kayala’ meaning ‘abode’ and ‘Vizhi’ meaning ‘Goddess of Fortune’. This name signifies that the goddess of wealth and prosperity resides in one’s heart or home.
